summary: Iter196 Front Door + multi-step case + professional additional-steps picker verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 unit tests + 5/5 live smoke tests pass against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend Playwright verified dashboard FrontDoorHero, /situation topic picker with all 4 tiles and cross-links, /case/:caseId page (SA-DEMO01 renders 4 step rows + progress + additional-tools; SA-999999 renders not-found), court-ordered badge via localStorage, and professional /professional/joint-alignment/new with pj-additional-steps + educational toggle showing/hiding required/optional pills. Legal disclaimer modal pre-dismissed via localStorage key sac_legal_ack_v1 to prevent click interception.

minor.issue: Success response does not echo `assigned_steps` in the create payload. Data is persisted correctly (GET /api/joint-alignment/case/{id} returns the full assigned_steps list with correct ordering), but the create-response omission means clients must round-trip to see the bundle. Consider including assigned_steps in the POST response for consistency with the case GET shape.

issues: Legal disclaimer modal covers the entire viewport on first visit and intercepts clicks on FrontDoorHero cards until acknowledged; not a defect per spec but any smoke test must dismiss it (localStorage.sac_legal_ack_v1 = {version:'v1'}) or use force=True clicks.

action_items: (Optional) Have POST /api/professional/joint-alignment/cases include the normalised assigned_steps array in its response to match GET /api/joint-alignment/case/{id}.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend joint_alignment_routes.py is now large (>2000 lines) — consider extracting assigned-steps normalisation + case-shape helpers into a dedicated module for maintainability.
POST /professional/joint-alignment/cases response shape and GET /joint-alignment/case/{id} response shape diverge in whether assigned_steps is included; align them for a consistent client contract.

Frontend CaseView progress text 'N of M steps completed' is caller-scoped (me.steps) while the visible list can include unrelated steps; consider clarifying the label (e.g., 'Your progress: N of M required') so users don't confuse global vs personal counts.

FrontDoorHero, Situation, CaseView, CourtOrderedCaseBadge, and ProfessionalJointAlignmentNew additional-steps picker all work as spec'd.
